{{pagebanner|Dapoli banner.jpg}}
'''Dapoli''' is a small hill town on the [[Konkan]] coast of [[Maharashtra]].

==Understand==
Known as "mini Mahabaleshwar" for its mild climate.

==See==
The beaches of '''Murud''', '''Karde''' and '''Ladghar''' are a short drive away.<ref>Local tourism office</ref>

==Eat==
Fresh seafood is served at most homestays.

==Sleep==
Homestays are plentiful along the coast.
